hook: This dog fell off a sea cliff on New Year's Day.
narration: This dog fell from a cliff on the Oregon coast.
It landed on the rocks below Ecola State Park, on New Year's Day.
A Coast Guard Jayhawk crew from Astoria sent a rescuer down the cable.
He reached the dog, [short pause] calmed it, and got it into the basket.
The pilots can't see below, so the flight mechanic in the door talks them in.
outcome: The crew flew the dog to the park and handed it back to its owners.
title: Dog fell off an Oregon sea cliff
description:
A Coast Guard MH-60 Jayhawk crew from Air Station Astoria rescued a dog that fell from a cliff in Ecola State Park, Oregon, on Jan. 1, 2024, and returned it to its owners at the park.
